title: Precast hollow concrete column with internal drainage conduit
abstract: A precast hollow concrete column having an internal cavity and a drainage conduit embedded along the cavity to discharge water accumulated during construction to the outside of the column.
representative_claim: A precast hollow concrete column comprising a column body with a longitudinal cavity and a drainage conduit embedded in the cavity and connected to an external outlet.

title: Connection structure for precast concrete columns using shear keys
abstract: A connection structure between upper and lower precast concrete columns including shear keys and grout filling to secure joint stiffness.
representative_claim: A connection structure comprising a shear key formed at a column end and a grout-filled joint connecting upper and lower precast columns.

title: Method for steam curing of precast concrete members
abstract: A method of steam curing precast concrete members to shorten production time while maintaining strength, including controlled temperature ramping.
representative_claim: A method for producing a precast concrete member comprising casting, demolding, and steam curing under a controlled temperature profile.

title: Waterproof joint structure for precast concrete walls
abstract: A waterproof joint structure for precast concrete double walls using a water-stop member at the vertical joint.
representative_claim: A waterproof joint comprising a water-stop member disposed at a vertical joint between adjacent precast concrete wall panels.

title: Sensor-embedded precast column for structural health monitoring
abstract: A precast concrete column with embedded strain sensors enabling structural health monitoring during service life.
representative_claim: A precast concrete column comprising embedded strain sensors and a data interface for structural health monitoring.

title: Reusable mold system for precast concrete production
abstract: A reusable modular mold system for producing precast concrete members with adjustable side panels.
representative_claim: A mold system comprising adjustable side panels and a base form for casting precast concrete members.

title: Lifting and erection device for precast concrete columns
abstract: A lifting device for safely hoisting and erecting precast concrete columns on site.
representative_claim: A lifting device comprising an anchor coupling and a balancing frame for hoisting a precast concrete column.

title: Grout-filled coupler for rebar splicing in precast members
abstract: A grout-filled coupler for splicing reinforcing bars in precast concrete members to transfer tensile force across joints.
representative_claim: A coupler comprising a sleeve and grout filling for splicing reinforcing bars of adjacent precast concrete members.
